correctness.rationale: The primary Cartan min-matrices admit the known unimodular gap diagonalization; Chen--Xi's singular-equivalence classification preserves precisely the multiset of non-unit gap entries, yielding stable integral congruence and isomorphic Cartan cokernels. The finite-abelian-group realization follows by choosing cumulative nilpotent block sizes.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. Prior work contains the Cartan calculation, its integral congruence, and preservation of the determinant under singular equivalence, but the checked sources and targeted synonymous searches did not locate the full Cartan-group/stable-form singular invariant or the nilpotent-centralizer realization statement.

value.rationale: The result strictly refines determinant preservation, distinguishes equal-determinant examples through different Cartan groups, supplies a stable integral obstruction to singular equivalence, and shows every finite abelian group occurs already for nilpotent one-matrix centralizers.
